name: MacGesture
description:
Mac-style touchpad gestures for GNOME Shell on Wayland.

• 3-finger horizontal swipe — live app switcher (windows slide with your fingers)
• 3-finger vertical swipe — configurable: Overview, volume, brightness, maximize/minimize, close, show desktop, or custom keybind
• 4-finger swipe — workspace switching, volume, brightness, media, Alt+Tab, or custom keybind
• 3/4-finger tap — configurable action

All gestures are fully configurable in Settings → MacGesture.
